_description: UNVERSIONED POLICY - Policy without version binding demonstrating drift risks

protocol_version._comment: All null - no version binding whatsoever

attack_exploits.name: version_confusion
steps: Policy committed in V1 with Ed25519-only multisig
V2 requires hybrid signatures for security
If system accepts unversioned policy, PQC security bypassed
attack_exploits.mitigation: Reject unversioned policies, require explicit version binding

attack_exploits.name: semantic_downgrade
attack_exploits.description: Force interpretation under older, weaker semantics
steps: Policy applied with V1 semantics despite V3 context
attack_exploits.mitigation: Version binding with semantic equivalence verification

attack_exploits.name: eternal_policy_exploit
attack_exploits.description: Policy never expires, outlives security assumptions
steps: Policy approved in 2024 with then-current assumptions
Policy still valid due to no expiry

attack_exploits.name: compilation_backdoor
steps: V3 system prefers STARKs but supports Groth16 legacy
